mapper.sql: select i.inventory_id, i.shop_id, i.sku_id, i.warehouse_code, i.country_code, i.total_qty, i.locked_qty, i.safety_qty, i.version, i.create_by, i.create_time, i.update_by, i.update_time, i.remark, s.sku_code, p.default_name as spu_name from inventory i left join product_sku s on s.sku_id = i.sku_id left join product_spu p on p.spu_id = s.spu_id
mapper.select: select * from inventory where sku_id = #{skuId} and total_qty - locked_qty > 0 order by (total_qty - locked_qty) desc, inventory_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into inventory (shop_id, sku_id, warehouse_code, country_code, total_qty, locked_qty, safety_qty, version, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{shopId}, #{skuId}, #{warehouseCode}, #{countryCode}, #{totalQty}, #{lockedQty}, #{safetyQty}, #{version}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update: update inventory set locked_qty = locked_qty + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where inventory_id = #{inventoryId} and total_qty - locked_qty >= #{quantity}
update inventory set locked_qty = locked_qty - #{quantity}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where inventory_id = #{inventoryId} and locked_qty >= #{quantity}
update inventory set total_qty = total_qty + #{quantity}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where inventory_id = #{inventoryId}
update inventory set total_qty = #{totalQty}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where inventory_id = #{inventoryId}
